prior_source: MetaG/manuscript/sections/methods.tex: Physical diagnostics, and SI S3
correction: Endo2023 experimental source had already been consulted in MetaG development and used for a preceding14-case neutral-water transfer-range panel. This is a new fixed-external-geometry component ablation on development-exposed reference chemistry, not independent experimental validation. Source/method independence and independent metabolic benchmark gates remain unfulfilled.
additional_condition_limits: Native nominal-water recipes can retain a small acetone fraction (preceding source audit estimates <0.3% v/v), finite concentrations, commercial purity/isomer qualifications and shared cycle-measurement uncertainties. These are not newly verified strict pure-water activity-standard references. No experimental-cycle covariance is propagated.
relationship_to_earlier14: Earlier MetaG14 compound geometries used source-corrected acrylate/methacrylate inputs. This new frozen external-geometry13 panel excludes the two unchanged FlexiSol mismatches and includes the singly stereogenic secondary FTOH as an enantiomer-insensitive hydration observable in achiral water. The two cohorts and their estimators are not interchangeable.
